# Solar payback calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/solar-payback/

Estimate simple payback from installation cost, generation and electricity value. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare an installation cost with assumed annual output, self-consumption and annual maintenance.

## Limits and checks

Simple payback excludes finance, degradation, tariff changes and time value of money. Exported energy may have a different value from self-consumed energy.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
